title: Paper Rerun: reproduction reports for published research code
description: We re-run published research code on the authors' data and report what holds: the numbers we got, every command and log, and what we had to fix to get there. Each reproduction is done by AI agents on one home computer and reviewed by a human before publication. This release covers eleven papers: LIANA+ (Nature Cell Biology 2024, reproduced), Pantheon+ (ApJ 2022, reproduced), Particle Transformer (ICML 2022, reproduced), miniprot (Bioinformatics 2023, partially reproduced), MatGL (npj Computational Materials 2025, not reproduced, checked twice independently), ProteinGym (NeurIPS 2023, run in our standard mode and through the full pipeline), LigandMPNN (Nature Methods 2025, run as a single-agent pilot and through the full pipeline), ACT DR6 lensing (ApJ 2024), CHGNet (Nature Machine Intelligence 2023), Cellpose3 (Nature Methods 2025) and PlantCAD (PNAS 2025), plus the method and the scripts.
